decisive_spans.text: On PET-CT, the mass demonstrated fluorodeoxyglucose avidity with an SUVmax of 5.2

response.rationale: The presence of fluorodeoxyglucose avidity with an SUVmax of 5.2 strongly supports lymphoma and contradicts abscess and teratoma. While metastasis can also be FDG avid, the normal brain and chest CT scans make it less likely in this case.
